hints.title: Earliest Index Filtering
hints.text: Store the first occurrence index for each distinct element value in elements.

hints.title: Harmonic Sieve Traversal
hints.text: Traverse multiples of each distinct element up to the maximum group size.

hints.title: Direct Multiple Lookup
hints.text: Record the minimum valid element index for each multiple and answer group assignments directly.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Applies harmonic series sieve across multiples up to M bounding operations by M log M.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Factoring every group independently takes quadratic time across large inputs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct-mapped integer array stores lowest index per multiple.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies harmonic sieve over multiples rather than repeatedly factoring group sizes.
